case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

Thank you for your offer and for your readiness to get started. We value the years of cooperation between our two family companies and want to find a fair solution for both.

Our data shows a different picture on two points:

Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

With that in mind, we would like to put forward the following proposal in good faith:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 27.45; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

We hope this gives us a sound basis for a lasting partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I checked your numbers on the quality and the other offer, and fair enough, you did your homework. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the rival quote and quality record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

I can do the 35 days lead time, but we have to stick to 30 days payment so I can pay my guys and material suppliers. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

For now, we can propose a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

We appreciate the fairness of your response, and we value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies.

We understand that your payment terms matter to you, and that you need to take this to your colleagues internally. To make that easier, here are two options we can stand behind:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.77; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.11; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Both options meet your lead time. We hope one of them gives you a good basis for a fair solution for both companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. If we stick to 30 days payment and 35 days lead time, I can give you my best price of €28.50 per unit. So our offer is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
